spans.s: क्षपणक a Jain grammarian quoted in the well-known stanza धन्वन्तरिः क्षपणकोमरसिंहशङ्कु which enumerates the seven gems of the court of Vikramāditya, on the strength of which some scholars believe that he was a famous grammarian of the first century B.C.
क्षमामाणिक्य a Jain grammarian who wrote a small grammar work known as Aniṭkārikāvivaraṇa.
क्स (1) aorist vikaraṇa affix sub- stituted for च्लि; cf.
, 46; e. g. अदृक्षत्, आश्लिक्षत्, अधुक्षत् cf. Kāś. on
,46; (2) kṛt affix स applied to the root दृश् preceded by a pronoun such as त्यद्, तद् etc. e.g. यादृक्षः, तादृक्ष: etc. cf. दृशेः क्सश्च वक्तव्य:
Vārttika. (3) affix स applied to the root गाह् or ख्या or कव् to form the noun कक्ष; cf. कक्षो गाहतेः क्स
क्सरन् Uṇādi affix सर; cf. तन्यृषिभ्यां क्सरन् Uṇādi
